input: Schedule a deep tissue massage for post-move recovery

gold.taskTitle: Book a post-move deep tissue massage
gold.taskDescription: Schedule a deep tissue massage appointment to aid physical recovery after a recent move.

questions.title: When exactly did you move or plan to move?
questions.description: Understand the move timeline to determine urgency and ideal booking window.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the massage be in?
questions.description: Identify the location to search for nearby massage therapists or studios.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred massage therapist or spa already?
questions.description: Determine if outreach to a specific provider is needed or if a new one must be found.

questions.title: Which specific body areas need the most attention?
questions.description: Clarify focus areas such as back, shoulders, or legs to communicate clearly when booking.

questions.title: What is your target date or deadline for this appointment?
questions.description: Establish a booking timeframe to prioritize scheduling urgency.

questions.title: What is your budget range for this massage session?
questions.description: Filter therapist or spa options based on price expectations.

questions.title: Do you prefer a studio visit or an in-home mobile therapist?
questions.description: Determine the type of service to search for, especially relevant if unpacking is still in progress.
